description: This file defines the Runtime and ExecutionContext classes for managing debugging, console message handling, and remote object management within a Firefox environment, including integration with Mozilla-specific components and services.

classes.name: Runtime
classes.description: Manages debugging sessions, console message listening, and execution contexts, supporting both worker and main thread environments.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript execution context, providing methods for evaluating scripts and functions, managing remote objects, and handling bindings.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an expression in a specified execution context.

methods.name: callFunction
methods.description: Calls a function within a specified execution context.

methods.name: getObjectProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a remote object.

methods.name: disposeObject
methods.description: Disposes of a remote object reference.

methods.name: createExecutionContext
methods.description: Creates a new execution context associated with a DOM window or global object.

methods.name: findExecutionContext
methods.description: Finds an execution context by its ID.

methods.name: destroyExecutionContext
methods.description: Destroys an execution context and cleans up associated resources.
